board: B9.1 · Animation editor — Entrance · Attention · Exit (Figma 429:2350)
_note: LEDGER J-429:2350 closed this row 2026-09-04 as 'already conformant —
AnimationEditor already renders every element the board shows'. That was a
claim about the element LIST, and it holds (12 / 8 / 5 presets, three tabs,
the timing block). It was not a measurement, and two things were off.
REACHED VIA PROBE: the editor takes `{animation, onChange}` and mounts with
no composer, so this is the shipping component with a real AnimationConfig.
The 320 host is the board's own card (429:2351) — the chip grid is
`repeat(3, 1fr)` inside the editor's 12 padding, so 320 is what makes a
chip 93 wide the way the board draws it. `fadeInUp` is selected because
429:2364 is the chip the board draws selected.
BOARD WON, twice:
429:2362  the preset chip is 40 tall. `padding: 12px 6px` on an 11px line
box measured 37, and nothing pinned the height — so the moment
a label wrapped, one chip in a row grew and the row lost its
baseline. Now an explicit 40.
429:2390  the TIMING label is 11 Semi Bold at 0.66 tracking. It shipped
12px with no tracking.
NOT CONFORMED — the SELECTED chip's fill, and this one needs a founder
ruling. 429:2364 fills it --flowbite/blue/500 #3F83F8 (and 429:2354 paints
the active tab's underline the same blue-500). The chip ships
--bk-accent #1A56DB. DESIGN.md is explicit and founder-locked: 'One accent
color: #1A56DB … One blue everywhere', and CLAUDE.md says not to deviate
from DESIGN.md without explicit approval. A board asking for a second blue
as a SELECTION fill is exactly the deviation that rule exists to catch, so
the accent stays and this is reported. The selected chip's LABEL (429:2365,
11px on --color/bg-card white) IS joined and passes — only the box is left
out, because a join compares every property of a node and the fill would
come with it.
NOT JOINED — 429:2353-2359, the tabs. chrome-ui `Tabs` is a shared
primitive; export-html-modal's recipe already records that its pill
treatment is cited to THREE boards (1172:4867, 1172:4825, 1164:4713). This
board draws a fourth reading — 11px on a blue-500 2px underline instead of
13px on an accent-tint pill. One screen board does not re-settle it.
429:2395/2401 the slider tracks — SliderField/Slider are shared, and the
board's 272 track width is its 320 card's arithmetic, not a spec.
THREE UNKNOWNS, not failures: the chip labels report line-height 15.7143px
against the board's `leading-[normal]`. flowbite's Button resolves `normal`
to a number; the board keeps the keyword. Same value, two spellings, and
the comparator cannot say so.
FOUND, NOT FIXED: the board draws three cards side by side — Entrance,
Attention and Exit each with their own visible chip grid. The product shows
ONE card and a tab strip. That is the right call for a 300-wide inspector
(three 320 cards need 1040), and the board is a documentation layout of the
three tab states rather than three panels the product should ship. Recorded
so nobody reads the frame as a missing feature.
ALSO FOUND: AnimationSection.tsx:156-170 renders a SECOND 'Generated CSS:'
block underneath the editor's own (AnimationEditor.tsx:198-213), so an
element with animation enabled shows the same declaration twice. Not visual
drift against this board — the board draws one — but it is what a user sees.
